description: Search the How pulsar compares catalog by free text — how pulsar compares on Silesia — gzip -9, pulsar 2.5.0, and xz -6 sizes. Read-only; returns matching entries with name, price, notes, and links. Use to find an entry by keyword; use measure_get when you already know the entry id.
